enunciado: Merge {1, 4, 9, 12} and {2, 3, 10, 15, 20} into a third sorted array, traversing both only once.
objetivos: Prepare the core idea of merge sort
pistas: Keep an index for each array and one for the result.
Copy the smaller of the two current elements.
When one runs out, copy what is left of the other.
